rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the natural world and the physical environment.

example.english: Nature is truly beautiful and worth protecting.
example.traditional: 大自然真係好靚，值得我哋好好保護。
example.jyutping: daai6 zi6 jin4 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hou2 hou2 bou2 wu6

rows.note: Use this for the innate character or true nature of a person or animal, especially when contrasted with upbringing or effort.

example.english: No matter how much they change, their nature is still so kind.
example.traditional: 就算佢點樣改，本性都係咁善良。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 keoi5 dim2 joeng2 goi2 bun2 sing3 dou1 hai6 gam3 sin6 loeng4

rows.note: Use this for the inherent qualities or general character of a thing rather than a person's personality.

example.english: The nature of this cleaning product is quite harsh, so do not let it touch your skin.
example.traditional: 呢種清潔劑嘅性質比較刺激，唔好掂到皮膚。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 ge3 sing3 zat1 bei2 gaau3 ci3 gik1 m4 hou2 dim6 dou3 pei4 fu1

rows.note: Use this when “nature” means a sort, type, or general class of thing.

example.english: By nature, these two kinds of tea taste very different.
example.traditional: 就種類嚟講，呢兩種茶嘅味道好唔同。
example.jyutping: zau6 zung2 leoi6 lai4 gong2 ni1 loeng5 zung2 caa4 ge3 mei6 dou6 hou2 m4 tung4
